Short title and commencement

ACT V OF 1991
ACT V OF 1991
SINDH FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Finance Act, 1964 and the Sindh Finance Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis-B-5/91, dated
13-6-1991.--The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 9th May, 1991 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 4th June, 1991 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the Sindh Finance (Amendment)
Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 12 of W.P. Act XXXIV of 1964

ACT V OF 1991
ACT V OF 1991
SINDH FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Finance Act, 1964 and the Sindh Finance Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis-B-5/91, dated
13-6-1991.--The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 9th May, 1991 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 4th June, 1991 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 12 of
W.P. Act XXXIV of 1964.-In the Sindh Finance Act, 1964, in section 12--
(i) after
subsection (2), the following new subsection shall be added:---
"(2-A)
There shall be levied a surcharge on the cess payable under subsection (1) at
the rate of fifteen paisa per 40 Kilograms to meet the expenses in connection
with the water supply and drainage schemes under taken by the Councils
constituted under the Sindh Local Government Ordinance, 1979."
(ii) In
subsection (3), between the word "cess" and the word
"payable", the words "and the surcharge" shall be inserted.

Amendment of section 8 of Sindh Act XV of 1975

ACT V OF 1991
ACT V OF 1991
SINDH FINANCE
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
An Act to amend
the Sindh Finance Act, 1964 and the Sindh Finance Act, 1975
[Gazette of Sindh,
Extraordinary, Part IV, 13th June, 1991]
No. PAS/Legis-B-5/91, dated
13-6-1991.--The Sindh Finance (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed by
the Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 9th May, 1991 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 4th June, 1991 is hereby published as an Act of the
Legislature of Sindh.
3. Amendment of section 8 of
Sindh Act XV of 1975: -In the Sindh Finance Act, 1975, in section 8--
(i) after
subsection (1), the following new subsection shall be inserted:--
"(1-A)
There shall be levied a surcharge on the fee payable under subsection (1) at
the rate of fifty paisa per 100 Kilograms to meet the expenses in connection
with the water supply and drainage schemes undertaken by the Councils."
(ii) in
subsection (2), for the words and figures "The fee under subsection
(1)" the words "The fee and the surcharge" shall be substituted;
(iii) in subsection
(3), for the words "The fee and" the words and comma "The fee,
surcharge and" shall be substituted.

Repeal of Sindh Ordinance III of 1991
